example: My roommate is always conspicuous because of her queer way of dressing.
example_zh: 我室友的奇異裝扮經常引人注目。
chinese: 顯而易見的；引人注目的
memory_hint: conspicuous 指很顯眼、引人注意。

example: They were arrested for conspiracy to overthrow the government.
example_zh: 因為他們密謀推翻政府所以被逮捕了。

example: The man standing beside the red car is a constable.
example_zh: 站在那輛紅色小汽車旁邊的人是一名警官。

example: The legislator will have to answer to his constituency for his actions.
example_zh: 立法委員必須向他的選民回答他的作法。
memory_hint: constituency 可指選區或選民群體。

example: They refused to put the new law into effect because it was not constitutional.
example_zh: 因為這項新法律不符合憲法，所以他們拒絕使它生效。
memory_hint: constitutional 指憲法的，也可指本質的。

example: The secretary told me her boss was in consultation and couldn't come to the phone.
example_zh: 秘書告訴我她的老闆正在商議事情，抽不出身接電話。

example: She fell in love with a man who had a contagious disease.
example_zh: 她愛上了一個有傳染性疾病的男人。
chinese: 傳染性的；會傳播的；有感染力的

example: The factory which discharged contaminants into the sea was closed.
example_zh: 那家向大海排放污染物的工廠被關閉了。

example: We can't eat the food which has been contaminated by flies.
example_zh: 我們不能吃被蒼蠅弄髒的食物。

example: She seemed lost in contemplation, sitting there for 2 hours without a word.
example_zh: 她似乎已陷入忘我的沉思中，坐在那兒一句話不說已經兩個小時了。

example: Whether or not they arrive on time is contingent on the weather.
example_zh: 他們能否準時到達要以天氣而定。
chinese: 視情況而定的；不一定的；偶然發生的

example: We must ensure continuity of food and medical supplies to the people in the stricken region.
example_zh: 我們應該確保持續提供食物和藥物給災區人民。

example: You said his remark was contradictory to the truth but do you know the truth?
example_zh: 你說他的說法與事實相矛盾，但你瞭解事實真相嗎？
chinese: 矛盾的；對立的；好反駁的

example: Anyone who contrives a way of solving the problem will be rewarded.
example_zh: 任何設想出解決問題方法的人都會得到獎勵。

example: He said religion was always a controversial topic.
example_zh: 他說宗教向來是一個有爭議的話題。

example: Top leaders of 3 nations convened in a friendly atmosphere.
example_zh: 三國的高層領袖在友好的氣氛中會談。

example: Thousands of people converged on the city for the big game.
example_zh: 成千上萬的人聚集在這個城市，觀看這場盛大的比賽。

example: She wants to buy a convertible sofa which can be converted into a bed.
example_zh: 她想買一張可變成床的轉換式沙發。

example: Convicted of murder, the man's bail was refused.
example_zh: 他因為被判謀殺罪，所以不能被保釋。

example: She expressed her intentions with conviction.
example_zh: 她有信心地表達她的意圖。

example: Your explanation sounds convincing but I can tell that you lied.
example_zh: 你的解釋聽起來很有說服力，但是我知道你在說謊。
chinese: 有說服力的；令人信服的

example: The general sent a convoy to scout the town before entering it.
example_zh: 那位將軍在進入該城之前派一支護送部隊去偵察。

example: If they had coordinated their efforts, the company would not have gone under.
example_zh: 如果他們同心協力，公司也不致破產。

example: We appreciated the cordial welcome given by the entrepreneur very much.
example_zh: 我們很感謝主人所給予的熱忱歡迎。

example: You are cordially invited to attend the meeting which will be held next week.
example_zh: 我們熱誠地邀請你參加下週舉行的會議。

example: Don't always cork your feelings up; it is not good for you.
example_zh: 不要總是堵住你的感情，這對你不好。
memory_hint: cork up 可比喻抑制感情。

example: He was awarded the Victoria Cross for his service in the medical corps during the war.
example_zh: 他因在戰爭中於醫務部隊服役而被授予維多利亞十字勳章。

example: I cannot correlate what happened yesterday with what you said just now.
example_zh: 我看不出昨天發生的事與你剛剛說的有什麼關連。
memory_hint: correlate A with B 表把兩者聯繫起來。

example: Exports in the first 2 months have increased by 5 percent compared with the corresponding period last year.
example_zh: 與去年同期比較下，頭兩個月的出口成長了5%。

example: How can you remain calm when you are confronted with a matter of cosmic importance?
example_zh: 面對重要的大事，你如何保持鎮靜呢？
memory_hint: cosmic 指宇宙的，也可比喻極其重大的。

example: Youngsters always think it is cool to be a rootless cosmopolitan.
example_zh: 年輕人常常認為四海為家的人很酷。
chinese: 世界主義者；四海為家者
memory_hint: cosmopolitan 可指四海為家的人。

example: How does the Earth rotate on its axis, clockwise or counterclockwise?
example_zh: 地球如何繞著地軸旋轉，順時針還是逆時針？
chinese: 逆時針方向地；自右向左地

example: The army staged a coup after the king died.
example_zh: 國王死後，軍方發動了一場政變。

example: You can redeem this coupon at any branch of that bank.
example_zh: 你可以在該銀行的任何分行兌現這種優待券。

example: The courier who delivered a parcel to our office left 10 minutes ago.
example_zh: 把包裹送到我們辦公室的郵差在10分鐘之前離開了。

example: The explosion which happened yesterday got massive media coverage.
example_zh: 昨天發生的爆炸得到傳播媒體的廣泛報導。
chinese: 覆蓋範圍；保險項目；新聞報導
memory_hint: coverage 可指新聞報導範圍。

example: She won the coveted position but felt unhappy and dissatisfied.
example_zh: 她得到了人人渴望的職位，但卻不開心也不滿足。

example: A campaign aimed at crackdown on gambling is being carried out thoroughly in that country.
example_zh: 嚴厲打擊賭博的行動正在該國全面展開。

example: The researchers said the diameter of the crater was measured using three independent methods.
example_zh: 研究者說火山口的直徑是用三種不同的方法測量出來。

example: The hinges creaked when I opened the door.
example_zh: 當我開門時，鉸鏈發出咯吱聲。

example: The credibility of the government was irreparably damaged after the newspaper revealed the corruption.
example_zh: 該報社揭發貪污後，政府的信譽遭到無可彌補的損失。

example: I'll be up the creek if I lose the job.
example_zh: 若我丟了這份工作就有麻煩了。
memory_hint: up the creek 表陷入麻煩。

example: He shed crocodile tears when he dismissed her from her job.
example_zh: 他把她開除時，假惺惺地流了鱷魚的眼淚。
memory_hint: crocodile tears 表假慈悲的眼淚。

example: He crooked his finger at us to tell us to go there.
example_zh: 他朝我們彎彎手指，叫我們過去。

example: My advice is that one should never take to crooked ways.
example_zh: 我的忠告是永遠別走歪門邪道。
memory_hint: crooked 可指彎曲，也可比喻不正當。

example: There was a cat crouching behind the sofa.
example_zh: 在沙發後面蜷縮著一隻貓。

example: The taxi cruised the streets, searching for passengers.
example_zh: 計程車緩慢行駛在大街上尋找乘客。

example: He bought a cruiser which can travel at a speed of 65 miles per hour.
example_zh: 他買了一艘遊艇，該遊艇航行的時速可達65英里。
memory_hint: cruiser 指巡洋艦或大型遊艇。

example: You had better sweep up the crumbs after eating the bread.
example_zh: 吃完麵包後，你最好打掃一下碎屑。

example: The earthquake crumbled many buildings and resulted in severe loss.
example_zh: 地震摧毀了許多樓房，造成嚴重損失。

example: I dislike those who crunch crisps at the movies.
example_zh: 我討厭那些看電影時嘎吱地嚼洋芋片的人。
memory_hint: crunch 指嘎吱作響地咬嚼。

example: You can eat some crunchy biscuits if you feel hungry.
example_zh: 如果你餓了，可以吃些鬆脆的餅乾。
memory_hint: crunchy 指酥脆、嘎吱作響的。

example: It is dangerous to walk on the snow; the crust on it is not thick enough.
example_zh: 雪殼還沒有凍硬；在上面行走是很危險的。

example: I want to buy a cookbook covering cuisine from Peking to Paris.
example_zh: 我想買一本從北京菜介紹到巴黎菜烹調方法的食譜。

example: His books are not very good, but they have a certain cult following.
example_zh: 他的書不是很好，但有一定的崇拜者。

example: Measures taken by the government didn't curb inflation.
example_zh: 政府採取的措施未能抑制通貨膨脹。

example: The local government imposed a curfew on the city after the war broke out.
example_zh: 戰爭爆發後，當地政府對該城實行宵禁。

example: If you want to be knowledgeable, you will have to study things not in the curriculum.
example_zh: 如果你想學識淵博，就必須學一些課程以外的東西。
chinese: 學校的全部課程；一門課程

example: He curried favor with his boss in order to be promoted.
example_zh: 他極力討好老闆以求被升職。
memory_hint: curry favor with 表拍馬屁、討好。

example: The girl is in the custody of her mother after her parents divorced.
example_zh: 父母離婚後，小女孩就由母親看護。

example: The daffodil, one of the first flowers of spring, is a symbol of hope.
example_zh: 水仙花是一種春天最早綻放的花，象徵著希望。

example: With a lot of work to do, she has no time for small chat with other dame.
example_zh: 她有許多工作要做，所以沒時間和其他女士閒聊。

example: I am looking for a shampoo that can help me get rid of my dandruff.
example_zh: 我想買可以幫助我去除頭皮屑的洗髮精。

example: Her husband darted an angry look at her because she said something wrong.
example_zh: 因為她說錯了話，丈夫就對她投射生氣的目光。
memory_hint: dart 可指快速投射或猛衝。

example: After the air raid there was debris everywhere.
example_zh: 空襲過後到處都是瓦礫堆。

example: Jane made her debut at a party when she was seventeen.
example_zh: Jane在17歲時，在一次派對上初次進入社交界。
chinese: 首次露面；初次進入社交界

example: Right now most countries have a decimal currency.
example_zh: 現在大多數國家使用十進位貨幣。
memory_hint: decimal 指十進位或小數的。

example: The department has little more than a decorative advisory function.
example_zh: 該部門只有一點裝飾性的諮詢作用。

example: From this fact we may deduce that she went to the party.
example_zh: 我們從這個事實可以推論她去了那個派對。

example: The expenses will be deducted from your salary.
example_zh: 費用會從你的工資裡扣除。
